body: That PR catches this problem only if the returned type is actually incompatible, but in the provided code a string literal is returned and a `StringName` is expected, which is valid. Even so, I can't reproduce this crash on a build from upstream (but I can reproduce it with the release installed on my system). This seems to have been fixed at some point, but I'm not sure when.

I tested with latest master [0304036be] and the bug was fixed. The mentioned PR was already merged and reverting it i get this crash (don't crash all the times, sometimes needs to try 5 ~10 times to crash):
